prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final original macOS/iOS-style application icon for OpenCode; artwork only, no mockup.
Primary request: A beautifully finished, modern, simple, premium app icon. One bold abstract symbol that remains clear at 16 and 32 pixels, inside a polished rounded-square tile. Calm, precise, confident visual identity.
Composition: perfectly straight-on square image, centered tile occupying the full canvas, rounded-square outer corners radius about 22%; completely plain uniform pale gray outside tile corners, no exterior cast shadow. Symbol occupies about 60 percent of tile. Clean continuous geometry, generous spacing, optically centered.
Style: beautifully restrained smooth gradients, soft optical depth, one tasteful highlight, almost graphic rather than a physical sculpture. Pixel-clean edges. No photographic staging.
Constraints: no letters, text, numbers, watermark, logo replicas, fake Apple branding, terminal, brackets, code glyphs, command symbol, infinity or ceramic loop, green, copper, orange, generic four-point AI sparkle, star, particles, fine lines, busy 3D sculpture, extraneous decoration. No multiple icons or contact sheet. Fill image with a single finished icon.
Subject and color: A deep midnight-indigo rounded square tile carrying one pearl-white broad fluid diagonal wave, formed by two connected soft bends like a folded current of light. The silhouette is a single substantial flowing swash with rounded ends; visually asymmetric and dynamic, no closed loop. Subtle glacier-blue shading on its underside, crisp white upper rim; extremely simple, no thin edges. Background softly gradients from royal blue at upper left to deep violet bottom right.
